presets.title: A2 Cafe Speaking
presets.brief: Students practise ordering food and drinks politely, asking about prices, and handling a simple problem in a cafe.
presets.vocab:
menu - list of food and drinks
Could I have...? - polite order
How much is...? - asking price
bill - money to pay
Anything else? - service question
presets.materials: Menu screenshots, role-play cards, price list, cafe dialogue model
presets.homework: Write a cafe dialogue with 8 lines and underline polite phrases.

presets.title: B1 Travel Problems
presets.brief: Students practise asking for help politely when travel plans go wrong. They learn useful request phrases, solve mini travel problems, and finish with a role-play.
presets.vocab:
delay - later than planned
reservation - a booking
Could you help me with...? - polite request
I am afraid there is a problem - polite phrase
Would it be possible to...? - polite request
presets.materials: Travel problem cards, short dialogue model, role-play cards, board timer
presets.homework: Write a dialogue between a traveller and a receptionist. Use four request phrases.

presets.title: B1 Present Perfect
presets.brief: Students contrast past simple and present perfect for life experience, recent events, and unfinished time periods.
presets.vocab:
ever - at any time
never - not at any time
already - before now
yet - until now
just - a short time ago
presets.materials: Timeline visual, gap-fill, speaking prompts, error correction cards
presets.homework: Write eight questions with ever/yet/already and answer them personally.

presets.title: B2 Business Email
presets.brief: Students analyse a formal email, improve weak phrases, and write a clear request to a client or colleague.
presets.vocab:
regarding - about
attached - included with an email
clarify - make clear
appreciate - be grateful for
look forward to - polite closing phrase
presets.materials: Model email, weak email rewrite, phrase bank, checklist
presets.homework: Write a 140-word formal email asking for clarification and proposing next steps.

presets.title: Kids Animals
presets.brief: Young learners learn animal names and actions through movement, images, guessing and a short chant.
presets.vocab:
cat - pet animal
dog - pet animal
bird - animal that can fly
fish - animal in water
rabbit - animal with long ears
presets.materials: Animal flashcards, action cards, memory game, simple chant
presets.homework: Draw three animals and write one simple sentence for each.

presets.title: IELTS Speaking Part 2
presets.brief: Students learn how to structure a two-minute IELTS long turn with a clear beginning, details, feelings and conclusion.
presets.vocab:
memorable - easy to remember
impression - opinion or feeling
unexpected - not planned
recommend - say something is good
fluently - smoothly
presets.materials: Cue cards, sample answer, timing tool, feedback rubric
presets.homework: Record a two-minute answer and self-check using the rubric.

activities.name: Prediction sprint
activities.teacher: Show the title or image. Students predict three words and one possible problem.
activities.student: Students share quick predictions and compare with a partner.

activities.name: Phrase auction
activities.teacher: Show useful and weak phrases. Students buy phrases they think are natural.
activities.student: Students justify choices and correct weak phrases.

activities.name: Information gap
activities.teacher: Give Student A and B different information. Set a clear outcome.
activities.student: Students ask questions to complete missing information.

activities.name: Error clinic
activities.teacher: Display anonymous mistakes from the task and guide correction.
activities.student: Students correct mistakes and explain the rule.

activities.name: Exit ticket
activities.teacher: Ask students to write one new phrase, one question, and one confidence score.
activities.student: Students submit quick reflection before homework.
